newsitem.title: UK: Oftel posts decision on BT intl circuit rates.
newsitem.headline: Oftel posts decision on BT intl circuit rates.

text.p: UK telecoms watchdog Oftel said on Tuesday it decided that British Telecommunications Plc should provide international private leased circuits to other operators on cost-based interconnection terms.
Oftel said the move, which affects circuits between two countries, would promote international services competition by resellers.
International operators had requested that BT be obliged to provide the circuits at cost-based interconnection rates, Oftel said in a statement.
BT shares were up 3p at 428.5p by 1000 GMT.
